additions.site_identity_review: Edged describes a single five-building campus at Castanheira do Ribatejo. MERLIN’s register distinguishes buildings 01–02 from 03–05 at the same Lisboa VFX site. The coordinate is the operator’s campus reference point.

locator.identity_review: Edged describes a single five-building campus at Castanheira do Ribatejo. MERLIN’s register distinguishes buildings 01–02 from 03–05 at the same Lisboa VFX site. The coordinate is the operator’s campus reference point.

status.summary: MERLIN reported that construction had started on Lisbon buildings 03–05. It put their combined planned IT capacity at 100 MW and targeted the first half of 2029 for service.

additions.distinctness_review: The baseline contains only buildings 01–02 at this campus. The operator’s five-building campus and the issuer’s separate phase entries identify the other three buildings as one construction project. The imported source and identity registers contain no Lisbon VFX or Castanheira project.
additions.successor_review: The issuer describes construction separately from ongoing leasing negotiations and a future service date. Edged’s undated design page does not establish delivery.

scoped_project_details.measurement_scope: Group of three buildings. An additional possible 20 MW is outside the construction total.

additions.name: XTX Markets Kajaani First Data Center
additions.site_identity_review: The Kajaani municipal permit names the XTX project site, its parcel and XTX Finland Oy. The inherited National Land Survey parcel is the reviewed locator for the parent campus. The operator places its first, second and third data centres at this campus.

status.summary: XTX opened the first Kajaani data centre on November 24 and uses it for the firm’s own computing. The reported 22.5 MW of IT capacity applies to this building.

locator.identity_review: The Kajaani municipal permit names the XTX project site, its parcel and XTX Finland Oy. The inherited National Land Survey parcel is the reviewed locator for the parent campus. The operator places its first, second and third data centres at this campus. The inherited polygon identifies the shared campus. The individual building and work limits have no separate geometry.

additions.distinctness_review: The complete current site, project, source import and identity records contain one XTX campus and a project for the second building. XTX explicitly identifies these three buildings as separate phases at the same campus. The existing parcel and site ID are reused. The unrelated CSC LUMI-AI establishment is at Renforsin Ranta in Kajaani.
additions.successor_review: The operator reports that its own computing is running at the first centre. The 2027 target is for the second building.

additions.name: CL8 Limassol data centre operations

status.summary: CL8 hosted visitors at its Limassol data centre on October 2 and demonstrated its services. It separately documents commercial data centre and colocation operations.

locator.precision: Representative interior point for the registered building at the commercial premises.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The government data do not specify a per-building positional accuracy or the extent of the operator’s tenancy.
locator.identity_review: The certification body identifies data centre activities at 1 Falea Street. A government record names Cloudlayer8 at this address and locates it within one registered building. The published point is the centre of that building.

additions.distinctness_review: No Cyprus projects or sites exist in the base. CL8, Cloudlayer8, Limassol and Lemesos variants, Falea and Athanasios identification were checked across all five identity layers. The nearest existing site is SERVERZ Kfar Saba Underground Data Center (Zim Urban complex, KS 50 zone), approximately 330 km away.
additions.successor_review: The operator’s October 6 report describes the October 2 visit. Its later November cloud-service descriptions corroborate the business but supply no later site-specific physical event. The earlier certificate establishes the operating address.

scoped_project_details.physical_civic_address: 1 Falea Street, Ayios Athanasios Industrial Area, 4101 Limassol, Cyprus
scoped_project_details.colocation: Commercial carrier-neutral data centre operated by Cloudlayer8 Ltd.

status.summary: MERLIN reported that construction was underway on Lisbon buildings 01–02, with power secured and leasing negotiations ongoing. The 80 MW is planned IT capacity across both buildings.

status_updates.identity_review: The two-building Phase II record and the issuer’s LIS-VFX 01–02 refer to the same development.
status_updates.successor_review: The filing targets December 2027 delivery for Phase II. The three additional Phase III buildings have a separate timeline.

status.summary: MERLIN reported that BIO-ARA 02 was nearing completion and fully leased. It still expected December delivery for the 48 MW building.

status_updates.identity_review: The issuer names the second Bilbao-Arasur building as BIO-ARA 02.
status_updates.successor_review: November reporting of delays concerns buildings 04–05 and a possible repowering of 01. The issued update separately describes the existing operating 03 and the future completion of 02.

status.summary: MERLIN reported that Madrid-Getafe 1 was fully leased and had begun generating cash flow in November.

status_updates.identity_review: The issuer names MAD-GET 01, the existing Getafe 1 building.
status_updates.successor_review: A possible 6 MW repowering of this building was still in negotiation. Getafe II is a separate project.

status.summary: MERLIN reported that demolition at Madrid-Getafe II was nearing completion. It still expected a construction licence in early 2027.

status_updates.identity_review: MERLIN distinguishes MAD-GET 02 site works from the operating MAD-GET 01 facility in the same report.
status_updates.successor_review: Demolition and the forecast licence support site preparation. The source gives no later construction or operating milestone for this building.

status_updates.identity_review: The operator CTO identifies the new AI facility as Sumaré 3 in Sumaré, São Paulo. This is the existing Sumaré 3 project on the campus, separately numbered from buildings 1 and 2.

status.summary: Ascenty CTO Rodrigo Radaieski reported that foundations and structural columns had been built at Sumaré 3. The operator expected the first phase to be available in September 2027.

status_updates.successor_review: Reviewed through November 25. The November 16 interview documents structural works and treats initial availability as a future September 2027 milestone. No later source documenting a subsequent stage was found.

status_updates.identity_review: Legnani specifically distinguishes the Google data center under construction in Canelones from Antel’s Pando operation, the anticipated Antel Las Piedras facility and the proposed Solaria project. The September project observation also identified Google’s Canelones development.

status.summary: Canelones governor Francisco Legnani reported about 720 people working on construction of Google’s data center. He discussed two separate Antel sites and the proposed Solaria project in the same interview.

status_updates.successor_review: The Presidency independently identified the Google project as under construction on November 10. Review through November 25 did not identify a later change of stage at the same project.

status_updates.identity_review: The October earnings call names the Lagos Nigeria facility and its approximate 38 MW design, matching the existing Nxtra Eko Atlantic project. Airtel’s separate interim results identify Nxtra as the division undertaking the Nigeria construction.

status.summary: On the October 30 results call, Airtel Africa CEO Sunil Taldar reported that construction had started at the Lagos data center and described approximately 38 MW of future capacity.

status_updates.successor_review: The October 30 results release also confirms ongoing construction. A review through November 25 identified no later primary operational, completion or more specific construction milestone at the Lagos project.

status_updates.name: Bitdeer Tydal — 121 MW IT conversion for Volta

status.summary: On November 10, Bitdeer reported construction underway on its Tydal conversion for Volta. The first two phases account for 121 MW of contracted IT capacity. Both had future service targets.

status_updates.identity_review: The same owner, town, tenant, phase capacity and lease described in the earlier announcement identify the contracted conversion. The October 31 portfolio table distinguishes the separate third phase.
status_updates.successor_review: The operator’s November report and earnings call still describe physical construction toward initial delivery. The location previously hosted bitcoin mining. Existing electrical capacity at the site does not establish that the conversion was operating.

context_updates.summary: XTX identified its second Kajaani data centre separately from the newly opened first building and the third building under construction. It expects the second facility to enter operation in 2027.
context_updates.identity_review: The operator numbers each building in the same campus portfolio. Its schedule for the second centre supplies context, while the June 25 installation report remains its dated physical-status evidence.

locator_corrections.reason: Replace the map-service redirect with the Basque Government’s registered installation point for the same Bilbao-Arasur campus.
locator_corrections.displacement_review: The government point is about 56 metres from the previous campus reference. It falls in parcel 47012387 of MERLIN’s approved two-parcel superblock. The operator’s Building 3 brochure gives a different reference point in the other parcel of the same superblock. The permit amendment identifies Building 2 as an expansion of this installation.

locator.precision: A registered installation point on the shared Bilbao-Arasur campus. The individual buildings and their boundaries remain unlocated.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The permit prints a metre-grid position without giving its surveyed horizontal accuracy.
locator.identity_review: The permit locates MERLIN’s installation in Building 3 of Arasur superblock 6. Its Building 2 amendment identifies the same facility. The municipal plan names both constituent parcels, and the provincial cadastre places the permit reference inside parcel 47012387.
